idea: "What's Missing?" #4 (JIMMY'S ROOM, Jimmy in HOME onesie on the round blue rug beside a big white paper taped on the light blue wall): Baby Jimmy's toddler crayon drawing of a gray BUNNY comes alive and hops on the paper – but it has only ONE ear ('Oh no! My bunny has one ear!'); 'Hop, hop, hop! Look at my bunny!'; Jimmy points at the empty spot and asks the viewer 'What's missing? Hmm?' (2 s humming pause) – 'An ear! An ear! A long pink ear!'; 'Magic crayon, draw with me! A long, long ear!' – the glowing pink magic crayon draws the second ear; chorus 'One ear, two ears! Bunny ears!'; copy-me 'Touch your ears! One, two! Yay!' and 'Hop, hop, hop! Hop with me!'; 'Happy bunny! Two long ears!'. Loop: the hook framing again with the bunny complete, 'Bye bye, bunny! Bye bye, friends!'.
lesson: Look carefully and spot what is missing: a bunny has two long ears; count one ear, two ears; touch your own ears.
calendar: Saturday slot 1 – "What's Missing?" signature episode #4 (ep.1 kitty tail 30 Oct, ep.2 car wheel 14 Nov, ep.3 snowman nose 21 Nov).

variety.outfit: HOME (light blue onesie with yellow star)

characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue short-sleeve onesie with a small yellow star, barefoot.
supporting: THE CRAYON BUNNY = a real toddler's crayon drawing of a simple cute BUNNY on a big sheet of white paper taped flat on the light blue wall: wobbly thick black crayon outlines, a round head and a round body with light gray scribbly crayon fill, two black dot eyes, a small pink triangle nose, a curved happy smile, a round white fluffy tail, little feet, and LONG upright bunny ears with pink scribbly insides. Flat crayon drawing on paper, not a 3D toy.

learning.goal: Spot the missing part: the crayon bunny has only one ear; Jimmy draws the second ear – one ear, two ears.
learning.shown_how: Hook/question: the gray crayon bunny with ONE long pink-inside ear and empty white paper where the second ear belongs, big beside Jimmy's face; shot 3 the pink magic crayon draws the second ear; shots 4-5 the bunny with two ears, Jimmy touching his own two ears.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:06 'What's missing? Hmm?' + 0:08-0:10 humming-only pause (question boing 0:07.4) -> 0:10 'An ear! An ear! A long pink ear!' + cheer
learning.copy_me: touch your ears one, two (0:19-0:22), hop with me (0:22-0:25), wave bye-bye
learning.fact_check: Frames checked at full size: f1/f2/f3 one ear + empty spot, f0/f4 exactly two ears; clips s1/s2 one ear for all 10 s (frames-to-video, same frame first and last); no letters or numbers anywhere.
learning.modeling: Jimmy notices a problem and fixes it himself by drawing; no wrong behaviour.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, soft daylight, big clear drawing beside his face, nothing scary.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: the crayon bunny comes alive with one ear
Magic crayon, draw with me! + loop ending + Bye bye, friends!

story_order.second ear: absent shots 1-2 (frames-to-video, same frame first and last), drawn in shot 3 (start frame: crayon raised beside the empty spot; appears ~6.5 s), present shots 4-5
